This page assembles the three figure columns into one layout. The plotting values and intervals are the same as in [A](05_figure3a_exchange_patterns.qmd), [B](06_figure3b_tokens_by_rank.qmd), and [C](07_figure3c_cooperation_gap.qmd). Each row has a colored relationship header and each data panel carries its A–C label.

# Row headers and layout

The layout functions use the figure color roles and the shared export helper. The three rows are I, non-friends; II, mutual friends; and III, sender-declared one-sided friendships. In row III, A includes both nomination directions while B and C use the sender-declared direction.
